in_marathi.name: Avdesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avdesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avdesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘avasthā’, which means 'to reside'. The name Avdesh is believed to mean ‘Lord’, ‘God’ or ‘Residence of God’. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with various gods and goddesses, particularly Lord Shiva.
